hip-14135.x: Harsh desert world in the Alpha Ceti system where Khan Noonien Singh and the Botany Bay crew were exiled prior to Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Major Federation core system and historical site in Star Trek Star Charts.
Primary naval hub of the UNSC Inner Colonies and site of the Fall of Reach in 2552.
Fortress world and second planet of Epsilon Eridani; headquarters of UNSC FLEETCOM and the SPARTAN-II program before its glassing by the Covenant.
First interstellar target reached by Bob-1 (HEAVEN-1), where he defeats the Brazilian probe and builds Riker, Bill, Milo, and Mario.
Heart of the Demarchist Glitter Band (10,000 orbital habitats) and Chasm City in the Epsilon Eridani system prior to the Melding Plague.
Nearby solar analogue scanned alongside Tau Ceti in the 1960 Project Ozma experiment conducted at Green Bank Observatory.
gaia-5164707970261890560.a: SETI Institute / Frank Drake / Breakthrough Listen

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Nearby young K-dwarf at 10.5 light-years harboring known giant planet and dual debris disks for disk-planet interaction study.
gaia-5164707970261890560.a: NASA Habitable Worlds Observatory Science Working Group
